name: Bad Honnef (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, white and red, charged in the upper part with the city arms of Bad Honnef (a chequy field with a Rhenish fess).
history: The city has been entitled to bear arms by deed of the Regierungspräsident in Cologne since 24 January 1973; by its charter it also bears a banner.

features.role: Bad Honnef arms — chequy with fess
